result.title: SchemaWeaver: Accelerating On-Device Mobile Agentic AI via Schema-Guided Parallel LLM Decoding
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices can act as agents that call external software tools to complete complex tasks, but the major challenge of supporting on-device mobile agentic AI with LLMs is the long latency of LLM tool calling on mobile devices. In particular, the decode phase is the main contributor of such long latency, but is hard to speed up on mobile processors as it is bound by memory bandwidth rather than compute power. To address this limitation, in this paper we present SchemaWeaver, a new on-device mobile agentic AI technique that enforces schema-guided parallel decoding in the decode phase of LLM tool calling, to reduce its latency by producing multiple tokens in each decode pass. SchemaWeaver can be generically applied to the LLM inference engine on mobile devices without involving any training efforts or changes on LLMs, and our experiment results on major mobile SoCs and LLM families show that SchemaWeaver can reduce the LLM tool calling latency by up to 3.9 times, compared to the competitive baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SchemaWeaver：在移动端 LLM 工具调用的解码阶段做 schema 引导的并行解码，使每次解码产出多个 token 以降低时延，无需训练或改动 LLM，在多种移动 SoC 与 LLM 上报告最高约 3.9 倍加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按结构 schema 约束、一次并行生成多 token 并缩短串行解码步数」的调度思路，可能为 LVR 中并行 latent 状态生成与结构约束解码的可核查线索；但该工作面向移动端工具调用延迟，未涉及视觉细节保留、推理状态更新或答案对 latent 内容的使用。
